The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. All technical bids will be deemed successful only after the technical evaluation committee's asessment and approval of the product. Bidder should present Rs.100/- affidavit of non-blacklisting in India before the bid end date and the STA MP should be during the bid duration it should not be old. 15. If the uploaded document is not Readable then the seller will be Disqualified 16. An Authorization Letter from OEM Must Be Submitted on the Letter Head Of OEM Addressing the Bid N umber And In Favout Of Tender Invitng Authority. 17. In additon to the electronic(uploaded) versions, all original documents must be physically submitted to the Nagar Panchayat Kakori, Lucknow Office on the bid submission date. All the documents must be duly si gned and stamped. Failure to submit both versions will result in automatic disqualification.
